The player holding the 3 of clubs starts and plays any set of cards of one rank: one card, a pair, three or four of a kind. Each player after that must beat the last play with the SAME number of cards of a higher rank, or pass. Ranks run from 3 (lowest) up to Ace, and the 2 is the highest. A 2 wins the trick on the spot.

When everyone else has passed, the player who played last takes the trick and leads the next one. With Ties switched on you may play the same rank as the last play, which skips the next player.

Four of a kind starts a revolution: the order of the cards turns upside down (3 highest, 2 lowest) until another four of a kind is played.

The first player out is the President and the last is the Scum. Before each new round the Scum hands its two best cards to the President (one card at a table of three) and gets cards back; the Vice-Scum and the Vice swap one card. Points: the President scores the most and the Scum nothing. The most points after the last round wins the session.

Be the first to play all your cards.

The player holding the 7 of diamonds starts by playing it. After that you may play a 7 of any suit to start that suit's row, or the card next to either end of a row that has started: a 6 or an 8 beside a 7, and so on, from the Ace up to the King.

If you can play a card you must. If nothing fits, you pass. With Pass penalty switched on, every pass adds 5 points to your score.

The first player to empty their hand wins the round. Everyone else scores the points left in their hand: Ace 1, number cards their face value, Jack 11, Queen 12, King 13. Keep playing rounds to build a running total.
